open_points.subject: FlowEdge propagation from an unexecuted source
open_points.question: Does “skipped node” mean only a source whose NodeExecution status is `skipped_by_guard`, or does it also include a source recorded `upstream_failed`?
options: Only `skipped_by_guard` sources propagate `skipped_by_guard`; an `upstream_failed` source propagates `upstream_failed`.
Both `skipped_by_guard` and `upstream_failed` sources count as skipped and propagate `skipped_by_guard`.
Any source that produced no value counts as skipped, including a failed source.
open_points.default_guess: Only `skipped_by_guard` sources count as skipped; `upstream_failed` propagates as `upstream_failed`.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution status precedence
open_points.question: At what scope do both conditions apply: competing edges of the same input port, different input ports of the same node, or also a constant-fed port alongside a failed incoming edge?
options: `upstream_failed` wins whenever any unsatisfied input of the node is blocked by upstream failure, even if another input would cause `skipped_by_guard`.
`upstream_failed` wins only when upstream failure and guard-based unavailability occur among edges into the same input port.
`upstream_failed` also wins for a constant-fed port if any incoming edge to that port comes from a failed source.
open_points.default_guess: Apply precedence across the whole node: any unsatisfied input blocked by failure makes the node `upstream_failed`, while a constant-satisfied port is excluded.

open_points.subject: FlowConstant and FlowEdge targeting the same input port
open_points.text: a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped
open_points.question: May an input port targeted by a FlowConstant also have incoming FlowEdges, and if so, can a disabled, skipped, or failed edge change the node's status despite the constant value?
options: The proof refuses any port targeted by both a constant and an edge.
A constant satisfies the port unconditionally; incoming edges cannot make it skipped or `upstream_failed`.
A constant and edges may coexist, but an upstream failure can still make the node `upstream_failed`.
A constant and an enabled edge may both deliver, subject to a separate producer-conflict rule.
open_points.default_guess: Refuse a flow in which a constant and any edge target the same input port.
